strongest_angle: Explore the hidden history and global influence of the Bank for International Settlements through insights from historian Adam LeBor in his book Tower of Basel.

key_facts.fact: Historian Adam LeBor documented the Bank for International Settlements in his book Tower of Basel as an influential global financial institution set up in 1930.
The Bank for International Settlements is described by Reuters as one of the world's most important yet opaque institutions, serving as a bank for central banks.
Adam LeBor wrote Tower of Basel as the first investigative history of the Bank for International Settlements, as noted by the Museum of American Finance.

numbers.label: Year of Bank for International Settlements creation

quotes.text: An absorbing and thorough examination of one of the world’s most important yet opaque institutions.
quotes.speaker: Reuters
